name: Card
description: Card (CARD) is a fixed-cap ERC-20 token on Ethereum. Maximum supply is hard-capped on-chain at 250,000,000 CARD; the contract has no fees, hooks, blocklists, or pausing.
notes: Official site: cp17.org, the coin's only web property. By decision the coin and the book are tied: direct purchases of The Cardinal's Promise include a fixed number of CARD, claimable via the site, from a published program wallet. Fill in contract addresses after deployment before submitting to Etherscan token update, CoinGecko, or a Uniswap token list. Etherscan requires a 32x32 PNG icon — use assets/logo-32.png.
